event: 43 Copa del Rey MAPFRE - ORC European Championship
procedural_matters: GBR 66 did not come to the hearing, the hearing proceeded in accordance with RRS 63.1(b).
GBR 66 presented photographic evidence of the damage and progress of the repair process on her boat.
The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).

The panel of the International Jury was changed in accordance with RRS 63.7(c)(1) keeping the majority of the original members: Andres Perez (ESP) and Pinar Coskuner Genc (TUR) were members of the original panel; Finn Mrugalla (GER) was added as a new member.
facts: GBR 66 provided both a report and photographic evidence of the repair process on her boat which shows that the repairs had not been completed.
GBR 66 did not sail in race 2, the short offshore race, which was sailed on 30 July.
At the time of the original hearing, it was uncertain if the repairs would be completed for racing on 30 July (see Fact Found No. 8 of the original hearing)
conclusions: The evidence that GBR 66 plans to present is new and might be significant. Therefore, the requirements in RRS 63.7(a)(3) for reopening the hearing are met.
